desc:
🎹 Welcome to Digital Piano! 🎹

The ultimate online piano game that everyone can play.

Here you can:

💸 Click a player’s character to donate to them
🎹 Practice and play your favorite songs
🎵 Use AUTOPLAY to play songs with our in-game piano autoplayer
🎼 Use the built-in MIDI Autoplayer to play songs from a MIDI file
💬 Leave comments on other players’ profiles
⭐ Build your reputation with positive feedback from other players
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and show your progress
🛍️ Earn Notes Currency and buy items or titles

Premium Players gets +1.5x Notes Currency Boost

👍 Enjoying the game?
Please give the game a 👍thumbs up and add it to your ⭐favorites to support us! <3

Join the Digital Piano Org. Group to get a Supporter In-Game Chat Tag and Title!

Thank you for playing Digital Piano!
